rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: moveup:1.2: can: The header prints 7.6.7.6.D. Stanza 1's line 2 (system 1's row) sings 6 syllables and line 3 (system 2's row) sings 7; moving the one-syllable O makes them 7 and 6, which the metre breaks. Capitals alone would not tell: O and the title after it both stand capital anyway. moveup:1.3: can: The header prints 7.6.7.6.D. Stanza 1's lines 3 and 4 (system 2's row) sing 7 and 6 syllables; moving the one-syllable O makes them 8 and 5, which the metre breaks. Capitals alone would not tell: O and the title after it both stand capital anyway.
